g.text: 1 cm = 500 m only when this image is printed 20 cm wide;
otherwise measure with the scale bar. Contour interval 10 m.

spot heights: A 1,500 m, B 1,540 m
Straight A–B: 4 cm × 500 m = 2 km. Road: 6 cm × 500 m = 3 km,
longer because it follows a different path; travel time and
Square ABCD: 2 km × 2 km = 4 km². A 1 cm square: 0.5 km × 0.5 km
Gradient A→B: rise 40 m over 2,000 m = 40:2,000 = 1:50, an
average; the section shows the slope is not uniform.
